title: Rehashing a full source for each reported range
claim: Each unsafe range rehashes its entire source name/value before checking an existing source entry, causing O(range count * source length) work on every sink report even when all ranges reference one source.

title: Predictable source-index collisions cause quadratic probes
claim: Unsalted FNV indexing into 512 linearly probed slots lets attacker-chosen distinct source values share one starting slot, causing O(source count squared) comparisons during reporting.
